requests.name: Health check
requests.description: Returns 200 with text/plain; charset=utf-8. Current body: "OK" (the text associated with the 200 status code). Does not check database connectivity. Source: main.go healthHandler.

requests.name: Create user
requests.description: Creates a user from JSON {"email":"..."}. Email has a UNIQUE database constraint; use a fresh email for repeated creation. Success: 201 JSON with id, created_at, updated_at, email. Copy id into the Local user_id variable. Malformed JSON: 400 plain text Invalid JSON. Current handler logs database errors but returns an empty default 200; do not interpret that as successful creation. No email-format validation is implemented. Source: main.go createUser; sql/queries/users.sql; sql/schema/001_users.sql.

requests.name: Create chirp
requests.description: Requires an existing user_id UUID. Send JSON with body and user_id. Set Local user_id from Create user before sending. Body length must be at most 140 bytes, as checked by Go len(string). Empty body is currently accepted. Space-separated words kerfuffle, sharbert and fornax are replaced by **** case-insensitively. Success: 201 JSON with id, created_at, updated_at, body, user_id. Copy id into Local chirp_id. Invalid JSON/UUID or zero UUID: 400 {"error":"Invalid request"}; oversized body: 400 {"error":"Chirp is too long"}; database errors, including nonexistent user: 500 {"error":"something went wrong"}. Source: main.go createChirp and profaneHandler; sql/queries/chirps.sql.

requests.name: List chirps
requests.description: Returns 200 JSON array ordered by created_at ascending. Each item has id, created_at, updated_at, body, user_id. Empty result is []. Database errors: 500 {"error":"something went wrong"}. No pagination or filters are implemented. Source: main.go getChirps; sql/queries/chirps.sql.

requests.name: Get chirp by ID
requests.description: Route: GET /api/chirps/{id}. Set Local chirp_id to a UUID returned by Create chirp. Success: 200 JSON with id, created_at, updated_at, body, user_id. Current handler omits assignment of body, so the returned body is an empty string. Invalid UUID: 400 {"error":"Invalid chirp ID"}. Missing record or database failure currently logs an error and returns an empty default 200, rather than 404/500. Source: main.go getChirp; sql/queries/chirps.sql.

requests.name: App index
requests.description: Representative request for the /app/ file server prefix. Serves index.html from the server working directory, normally 200 text/html. Every request through this prefix increments the visit counter, including asset and missing-file requests. /app/assets/logo.png is another valid example. Missing files return 404. The prefix is registered without a method restriction; this collection uses GET for normal browsing. Source: main.go route registration and middlewareMetricsInc.

requests.name: Visit metrics
requests.description: Returns 200 text/html; charset=utf-8 with the current /app/ request count. The counter is held in memory and resets on server restart. This endpoint does not itself increment the counter. Source: main.go metricsHandler.

requests.name: DESTRUCTIVE - delete users and chirps, reset counter
requests.description: DESTRUCTIVE: deletes ALL users, which cascades to ALL chirps via the foreign key, and clears the visit counter. Only allowed when server PLATFORM=dev; otherwise returns 403 with an empty body. On success returns 200 text/plain; charset=utf-8 with Hits: <previous count>. No request body or authentication. Current handler ignores database deletion errors, so 200 does not guarantee deletion succeeded. Never include this request in an indiscriminate workspace/folder send. Source: main.go resetHandler; sql/queries/users.sql; sql/schema/20260826010121_chirps.sql.
